config.expected_if_false: In at least one seed the force margin is < 0.10 or trained force R2 is < 0.60. That would mean fixing m2 removes most N=64 force decodability, and the paired arms then cannot separate the m2 and 1/r^2 parts.
config.expected_if_true: In both seeds the final best-layer force margin is >= 0.12 (beats_control true), trained force R2 is in [0.62, 0.85], and the headroom-normalised accel_step margin (R2 - control)/(1 - control) is in [0.55, 0.85].
config.hypothesis: Reference arm for the m2-fixed decomposition. With m2 fixed at 0.5 (force = 0.5/r^2), N=64 models (seeds 20-21, data_seed 0, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], 3000 steps, best-of-3 controls) still decode force above control, at a level comparable to the wide-m2 N=64 runs of the same seeds (trained force R2 0.726/0.737, margin 0.215/0.261). This arm anchors the paired N=128 and N=256 m2-fixed arms proposed this cycle. All values are read from run-record probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded. The max-over-layers trajectory field is never used.
